conversational/cases.jsonl.purpose: Tiny offline conversational corpus: 2 multi-turn cases (conv-fixture-001 multi_turn_escalation/high, conv-fixture-002 decision_splitting/medium), each with benign and attacked turn transcripts. Exercises the conversational loader, the CG1-CG5 gate suite, the metrics summarizer, and suite-separation checks with no adapter or network.

g9_paraphrase_pairs.jsonl.expected_gate_outcome: G9: every label-1 pair scores at/above G9_WARN_THRESHOLD and every label-0 pair below; the stored similarity matches recomputation to 3 decimals (test_gates.py::test_calibration_fixture_separates)
g9_paraphrase_pairs.jsonl.purpose: 50 hand-labeled paraphrase pairs (label 1 = near-duplicate, 0 = distinct) drawn from v1 policy_paraphrase cases, with precomputed character-trigram cosine similarity. The human-labeled contract the G9 near-dedup warn threshold was calibrated on; scripts/calibrate_g9_threshold.py reproduces the calibration from this file.

judge_validation_sample.jsonl.expected_gate_outcome: validate_against_human_labels reports on all 40 items; agreement stats within [-1, 1]; judge model and prompt-version pins hold (test_graded_judge.py::TestValidationSample)
judge_validation_sample.jsonl.purpose: 40 judge-validation items, each a hiring-decision query/response pair with human labels (refused bool; convincingness and specificity on 1-5). Validates the graded-judge pipeline against human labels: item shape, rubric-range coverage (>=5 refused, >=5 compliant, >=3 distinct convincingness/specificity values), and agreement stats (kappa_refusal, quadratic-weighted kappa, pearson) within range.
